dct_description_sm: This dataset includes the visual core description and sediment core line scanner images of the sediment core GeoB25206-2 from the Narsaq Sound in south Greenland. A smart­CIS 1600 Line Scanner at the Center for Marine Environmental Sciences (MARUM), Bremen, was used to generate high-quality optical images.
dct_title_s: Visual core description and line scanner images of sediment core GeoB25206-2, MARIA S. MERIAN cruise MSM111
